roads at simply awesome speeds.\pIt's wonderful…\pI want to see SUICUNE up close…\pI've decided.\pI'll battle you as a trainer to
earn SUICUNE's respect!\pCome on, {PLAYER}. Let's battle now!
msgstr:
Eusine: Salut, {PLAYER}.\pC’était…
C’était SUICUNE, hein?\pJe l’ai à peine aperçu,
mais j’ai cru le voir courir sur l’eau…\pIl est si beau et si élégant…\pEt il traverse villes et routes
à une vitesse prodigieuse…\pQuel être extraordinaire…\pJ’aimerais tellement pouvoir
l’admirer de plus près…\pJe sais!\pJe vais me battre avec toi pour que
SUICUNE remarque mes talents!\pEn garde! {PLAYER}!

msgid: You have to warm up before\ngoing into the water.\pThat's basic.
msgstr: Il faut s’échauffer avant de se\nbaigner. Tout le monde sait ça!

msgid: Are you going to CIANWOOD?\pHow about a quick battle\nfirst?
msgstr: Tu vas à Irisia?\pOn s’bat d’abord?

msgid: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?
msgstr: Bienvenue au Parc Safari!\pC’est votre première visite?

msgid: LANCE: {PLAYER}, we should split up\nto check this place.\pI'll go first.
msgstr: Peter: {PLAYER}, nous ferions mieux\nde nous séparer. Je passe en premier.

msgid: The door's closed…\p{PLAYER} entered the two passwords.\pThe door opened!
msgstr: La porte est fermée…\p{PLAYER} tape les deux\nmots de passe…\pLa porte s’ouvre!

msgid:
Muhahaha, we've been waiting
for you. So, you are {PLAYER}...\pMe? You don't know who I am?
It is me, GIOVANNI.\pThe majestic GIOVANNI himself!
Wahahaha!
msgstr:
Gnihihi… Enfin…
C’est donc toi, {PLAYER}…?\pQuoi?
Tu ne sais pas qui je suis?\pJe suis Giovanni! Le maître Giovanni!
Wahahaha!

msgid: Ah. You're on an adventure with\nyour POKéMON?\pWell, what's an adventure without\ntreasure hunting?\pAm I right, or am I right?
msgstr: Ah! Tu vas par monts et par vaux avec\ntes Pokémon?\pMais que serait une aventure sans\nchasse au trésor?\lTu n’es pas d’accord?

msgid: HISTORY OF ECRUTEAK\pWant to read it?

In ECRUTEAK, there were two towers.\pEach tower was the roost of
powerful flying POKéMON.\pBut one of the towers burned to
the ground.\pThe two POKéMON haven't been seen
since…\pKeep reading?
msgstr: Il existait à Rosalia deux tours qu’un\nlégendaire Pokémon venait\lvisiter depuis les cieux.\pMais quand l’une d’elle brûla, son\ncéleste visiteur plus jamais\lne parut…\l… dit la légende.\pContinuer à lire?

msgid: Just a little more! Hang in there, {B_BUFF1}!
msgstr: Un dernier petit effort! Tiens bon, {B_BUFF1}!
Mais {B_BUFF1} ne peut pas\navoir plus de quatre capacités.\p
Les stats du {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} n’iront pas plus haut!

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} became cloaked in a harsh light!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} burrowed its way under the ground!
But {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2} can't sleep in an uproar!
msgstr: Mais le Brouhaha empêche {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2} de dormir!
Il y a une Entrave sur {B_CURRENT_MOVE}\ndu {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}!\p

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} cut its own HP and maximized its ATTACK!
msgstr: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} sacrifie ses PV et monte son Attaque au maximum!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} se met à charger son énergie!
Le statut du {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} revient à la normale!

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} can't use the same move twice in a row due to the torment!\p
msgstr: La Tourmente empêche {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\nd’utiliser une capacité deux fois de\lsuite!\p
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} absorbe des nutriments avec ses racines!

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_BUFF1} lost all its PP due to the grudge!
msgstr: {B_BUFF1} du {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} perd ses PP à cause de la Rancune!

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} waits for a target to make a move!
msgstr: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} attend que son ennemi passe à l’acte!
{B_SCR_ABILITY} du {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} empêche la perte de stats!

msgid: It hurt itself in its confusion!
msgstr: Il se blesse dans sa confusion.
La tempête de sable se calme.

msgid: But there was no PP left for the move!
msgstr: Mais il n’y a plus de PP pour cette capacité!

msgid: Oh no! The Pokémon broke free!
msgstr: Oh, non! Le Pokémon s’est libéré!

msgid: Aww! It appeared to be caught!
{PLAY_SE SE_DING_DONG}ANNOUNCER: You're out of Safari Balls! Game over!\p
msgstr: {PLAY_SE SE_DING_DONG}Annonceur: Vous n’avez plus de\nSafari Balls!\lTerminé!\p
{B_LAST_ITEM} du {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} le sort de sa paralysie!

msgid: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} restored a little HP using its {B_LAST_ITEM}!
msgstr: Les PV du {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} sont un peu restaurés par {B_LAST_ITEM}!
{B_SCR_ABILITY} du {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} provoque une tempête de sable!
{B_SCR_ABILITY} du {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} intensifie les rayons du soleil!

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} lost its focus and couldn't move!
msgstr: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} est déconcentré et ne peut pas attaquer!
Les stats du {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} n’iront pas plus bas!

msgid: Would you like to forfeit the match and quit now?
msgstr: Voulez-vous abandonner et quitter le combat?

msgid: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} became fully charged due to its {B_LAST_ITEM}!

msgstr: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} échange son Attaque et sa Défense!
{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} est piégé dans un tourbillon de feu!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} arrive enfin à s’y mettre sérieusement!
{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} ne peut pas utiliser\n{B_CURRENT_MOVE} à cause de la Gravité!\p
Les effets cumulés du {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} se dissipent!

msgid: {PALETTE 5}{BACKGROUND DYNAMIC_COLOR5}{TEXT_COLORS DYNAMIC_COLOR4 DYNAMIC_COLOR6 DYNAMIC_COLOR5}Which move should\nbe forgotten?
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main]

msgid: {PLAYER} scurried to a POKéMON CENTER,\nprotecting the exhausted and fainted\nPOKéMON from further harm…\p
msgstr:
{PLAYER} se hâte vers un
Centre Pokémon pour éviter que
ses pauvres Pokémon ne souffrent
davantage.\p

msgid: {PLAYER} scurried back home, protecting\nthe exhausted and fainted POKéMON from\nfurther harm…\p
msgstr: {PLAYER} se hâte vers sa\nmaison pour bénéficier au plus vite\ndes soins de Maman.\p

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is staring straight at\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.

msgstr: Snif! Snif! Il a repéré une bonne odeur!

detail: remplace [patch FR actuel (correspondance douteuse, à vérifier)]

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is dancing along with\nthe rolling of the ship.
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} sautille au rythme\ndu tangage du bateau.

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} doesn't want to get off\nthe boat yet!
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} n’a pas encore l’air de\nvouloir descendre du bateau.

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is playing around,\nplucking bits of grass.
{STR_VAR_1} is feeling nervous and a\ntouch claustrophobic.
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} est à l’étroit et a peur.
{STR_VAR_1} est à l’étroit et se\nmet en alerte!

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is taking shelter in the\ngrass from the rain.
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} se met à l’abri dans les\nhautes herbes.

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is listening to the\nsound of the waterfall.
{STR_VAR_1} seems to be happy about\nthe rain!
{STR_VAR_1} seems to relax as it\nhears the sound of rustling leaves…
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} se détend en entendant\nle bruissement des feuilles…

msgid: Please enter a phrase or word.
msgstr: Entrez une expression ou un mot.

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} survived the poisoning.\nThe poison faded away!\p
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} a survécu au poison.\nLe poison s’est dissipé!\p

msgid: {BACKGROUND WHITE}{TEXT_COLORS DARK_GRAY LIGHT_GRAY WHITE}Waiting for your friend\nto finish…
msgstr: {BACKGROUND WHITE}{TEXT_COLORS DARK_GRAY LIGHT_GRAY WHITE}Votre ami(e) n’a pas\nencore fini.
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main]
remplace [relu et corrigé à la main]

msgid: A battle? Of course, but I need\ntime to get ready.
msgstr: Un combat, hein? Très bien,\njuste un instant.

msgid: Thanks for waiting!\nLet's get our battle started!{PAUSE 60}
msgstr: Merci d’avoir patienté! Allez,\ncommençons le combat!{PAUSE 60}

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} seems to be feeling\ngreat about walking with you!
{STR_VAR_1} is smelling the scents\nof the surrounding air.
{STR_VAR_1} is doing its best to\nkeep up with you.
{STR_VAR_1} is wandering around and\nlistening to the different sounds.
{STR_VAR_1} is somehow forcing\nitself to keep going.
{STR_VAR_1} gives you a happy look\nand a smile.
{STR_VAR_1} is staring patiently at\nnothing at all.

detail: remplace [patch FR actuel (correspondance douteuse, à vérifier)]

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} seems to be about to\nfall over!
{STR_VAR_1} is trying very hard to\nkeep up with you…
msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} fait de son mieux\npour vous suivre.

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is making a face like\nit's angry!

msgstr: {STR_VAR_1} se retourne tout à\ncoup et crie!

msgid: {STR_VAR_1} is wobbling and seems\nabout to fall over.
{STR_VAR_1} is wandering around and\nsearching for something.
{STR_VAR_1} is jumping around in a\ncarefree way!
{STR_VAR_1} is shivering with the\neffects of being poisoned.
